description: C63 acceptance on localhost through Chrome DevTools MCP, in a new agent tab closed at the end. ULH config 15268 (SB + SC, 5 1/8 inch top). Lift and drops are mouse events dispatched on the scene canvas; no scene setter is called. Expects the dev server on 5173 and takes about 4 minutes.

args.function: async () => { const q = window.__c63; const s = await q.state(); const sb = s.cabinets.find((c) => c.type.includes("sink")); const widths = await q.widths(sb.id); await q.deselect(); return { width: sb.w, widths }; }

async () => { const q = window.__c63; const before = await q.state(); await q.enterDrag(before.top.id); const lifted = await q.liftByPointer(0.27); const hosted = await q.waitFor(async () => (await q.state()).top.hosted, 20000); await q.sleep(2500); const a = await q.state(); window.__c63conv = a.cabinets.find((c) => !before.cabinets.some((b) => b.id === c.id)).id; return { lifted: lifted.off, hosted, sessionClosed: q.overlay() === null, ...(await q.brief()) }; }
async () => { const q = window.__c63; const widths = await q.widths(window.__c63conv); await q.deselect(); return { widths }; }

async () => { const q = window.__c63; const len = async () => { const t = await document.querySelector("iframe").contentWindow.ConfiguratorAPI.countertop.getState(); return t.customLength; }; const resized = await q.resize(window.__c63conv, '19.7"', 50); const s = await q.state(); await q.enterDrag(s.top.id); const poseBefore = (await q.state()).top.off; const lengthBefore = await len(); const d = await q.dropBy((t) => t.pending === "fits"); q.release(); const shown = await q.waitFor(() => q.message(), 15000); await q.sleep(2000); const end = await q.brief(); return { resized, poseBefore, lengthBefore, loweredOverlay: d.lowered.overlay, hit: d.atTarget.hit, message: shown, poseAfter: end.top.off, lengthAfter: await len(), hosted: end.top.hosted, cabinets: end.cabinets }; }
